business_problem: Xiaomi needed to replace fragmented customer service and spare-parts systems that could not support fast global growth, local compliance, or real-time visibility across post-sales operations.
solution_summary: As Xiaomi expanded into more than 100 markets, its self-developed support tools and third-party apps left customer service teams switching between channels and systems while spare-parts operations ran without a unified data platform. Microsoft helped Xiaomi build a cloud-backed CRM and post-sales supply-chain environment that could connect dozens of internal and external systems in six months and deliver one consistent experience across countries, channels, and languages. Key components include Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, Power Apps, Power Virtual Agents, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, and Azure Translator. Xiaomi launched the system globally in 2022, gave agents a unified multi-channel platform, and extended post-sales coverage to 80 countries and 10 regions with real-time spare-parts visibility and stronger compliance support.
